title: PaymentsPaymentFailedPayload
description: Payload of `payments.payment.failed` version 1. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know.

purpose.description: An order's payment or a Wallet top-up.

order_id.description: The order, for an order's payment.

partner_id.description: The order's Partner; `null` for a top-up.

location_id.description: The order's Location; `null` for a top-up.

method.description: How the rest is paid after the Wallet.

status.description: The payment's status after the change.

version.description: The payment's version after the change, rising with every change.

attempt_id.description: The try that failed; `null` when the payment failed without one.

message.description: A sentence a screen or a message may show to the customer.

final.description: Whether the payment failed for good; otherwise the customer may try again.

money.description: An amount in minor units with its ISO 4217 currency.

minor_units.description: The amount in the currency's minor unit.
